remaining.problem: Simulated hypothesis: Mira chooses Russian and then tries to decide whether her no-key PDF is ready for class. Profile guidance changes to Russian, but the no-key warning, outline-only status explanation, quality disclaimer and Outline PDF control remain English in the observed screenshots and templates. A reader with limited English may still misread the green compiled badge as coursework readiness.

remaining.suggestion: Provide Russian equivalents for the no-key limitation, outline download label and content-review instructions when Russian is selected; retain the explicit availability-versus-quality distinction.
